summary: xAI announced that Grok and X Premium subscribers can now access Grok models, including grok-build-0.1, inside the third-party agentic terminal environment Warp.

practices.reason: Adds a new connection path (subscription-based access to grok-build-0.1) inside a third-party developer tool, but requires no engineering work beyond an individual user connecting an existing subscription.
practices.quote: Open the "Agent > Warp Agent" settings page and click "Connect SuperGrok subscription"
